I've successfully completed all 12 SEO tasks for the Lasarz Immobilienbewertung website. 

## Summary of Completed Tasks:

✅ **Structured Data Implementation**: Added Organization Schema to layout.tsx and all other required schema markups (FAQPage, BlogPosting, Article, Breadcrumb, Person, WebPage)

✅ **H1 Tags Fixed**: Added proper H1 tags to all pages including homepage, blog, contact, about, FAQ, team, service pages, and city pages

✅ **Social Media Meta Tags**: Implemented complete Open Graph and Twitter Card tags for all pages

✅ **Canonical Tags**: Added canonical URLs to every page pointing to correct https://lasarz.com URLs

✅ **Alt Texts Fixed**: All images now have descriptive German alt text

✅ **Heading Hierarchy**: Fixed all heading structures to maintain proper semantic HTML

✅ **Meta Descriptions**: Added compelling 150-160 character meta descriptions to all pages

✅ **Breadcrumb Navigation**: Created and implemented Breadcrumb component on all pages

✅ **Sitemap & Robots.txt**: Optimized sitemap.xml with all pages and correct priority values

✅ **Build Verification**: Successfully ran npm run build with no errors

✅ **Documentation**: Created comprehensive docs/seo-fixes-applied.md documenting all changes

The website now has a complete SEO foundation that will improve search visibility, click-through rates, and overall search engine performance while following German SEO best practices and accessibility standards.
